title: AKOS knowledge pack metadata.yaml
description: Validates packs/<domain>/<name>/metadata.yaml. schema_version 1 is the versioned, strict contract: schema_version and the 7 fields already universal across the corpus are required, additionalProperties is false at the root and every nested object, and an unknown top-level or nested key is an error, not a silently-ignored typo. All 54 non-personal packs were migrated to carry schema_version: 1 by bin/migrate-pack-metadata.py before this schema tightened (see docs/contracts/knowledge-pack.md). New optional fields are additionally listed in x-akos-recommended: absence there produces a warning, never an error.

schema_version.description: Which version of this contract the file was authored against. An unknown value must fail explicitly, never fall back to the current schema.

domain.description: The domain directory it lives under, e.g. 'ux', 'security'.

platform-scope.description: Present on a small number of packs to narrow which platform they apply to (e.g. iOS, Android).

items.description: Attribution only per core/source-policy.md — either 'author' or 'org' is typically present, but neither is required by the schema since real content uses both patterns depending on the source type (a named author vs. an organization like W3C).

id.description: Default: '<domain>/<name>'. Populated by the metadata migration.

review_after.description: Cadence is authority-level dependent: 18mo for L0-1 (standards churn slowly), 12mo for L2, 9mo for L3-4. Computed by the migration; a maintainer may override by hand.

replacement.description: Pack id that replaces this one, when deprecated: true.

profiles.description: Advisory routing narrowing only. Absence means 'applies to all six profiles.' Does not replace or duplicate core/reasoning-profiles.md's per-agent weight table.

dependencies.description: Packs this one's guidance is genuinely incomplete without. Expected to stay empty/absent for nearly all packs — each is deliberately self-contained. Not materialized by migration.

conflicts.description: Pre-registered known tensions with another pack, feeding core/conflict-resolution.md's canonical rulings. Not materialized by migration — populated by hand when a real conflict is identified.
